title: board-files test times out on the Windows CI job
notes: PR #421's windows job (a PR not touching board files) failed src/main/board/board-files.test.ts 'names a board.json that does not parse on a read without salvage' at 6.4 s, over vitest's 5 s limit, same pattern as finished-work.test.ts (d976a3c6, #404): likely git or process spawns that are slow on the Windows runner. Find what the test spends its time on from the run log and make it fast; raise the timeout only for that test if that is the honest fix, saying why.

comments.body: Pull request #422 opened: Write an empty board in the board-files test of a broken board.json https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/422

Review loop: floor-addressed after 2 rounds, CI green on the head commit, ready to merge. Step 1 printed 'was ready'. Round 1 commit e40b300e: 60 s timeout on the whole describe('the folder') block, matching the other blocks (cause named as a disk stall, not the writes), on top of the emptyFolderBoard starts. Still open, low: the PR title and description still say the timeout was left alone; retitle them to describe the block timeout.
Pull request #422 merged: Give the folder board-files tests the 60 s timeout the other blocks have https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/422
